    Forge-Quench¶

    [!INFO] Hammer, coal, and water that sings — Day 5, Month 2, the cold-forged heart of Kobre Celebrated on the 5th day of the 2nd month (Ge'orian Calendar) — deep winter, when the forge burns hottest.

    Origins¶

    Forge-Quench is the winter forge festival of Kobre — the dwarven continent west of Tuba where Dwarvism's Coal Doctrine is the spiritual heart. In the Coalsteel Kingdom (southeast to central Kobre), the doctrine teaches Life should be treated as coal — burn peacefully in the dark to enlighten the world: silent craft, communal hearths, ancestor coal added to the family fire. The first Forge-Quench was the night the Coalsteel Kingdom's great communal hearth was rekindled after the continent's Hybrian-engineered Homunculi war left it cold. Rather than mourn, the Coal dwarves hammered. The Homunculi Kingdom homunculi heard the hammering across the border and, that year, did not raid.

    Rituals¶

    • Silent Hammering — from dusk to midnight, Coal dwarves work without speaking. The only sound is hammer on anvil — the Coal Doctrine prayer.
    • The Quench — at midnight, the year's masterwork (blade, gear, or plate) is quenched in snow-melt drawn before dawn. The hiss is listened to like an oracle — a clear sing is a good year; a dull thud is a warning.
    • Ancestor Coal — a piece of coal from each family's cremation pyre is added to the communal hearth. The dead's warmth joins the community's warmth.
    • Gear Meshing — homunculi-forged Kobran Gear sets are stacked and turned — if counterfeit teeth are off by a hair, they jam.

    Who Celebrates¶

    Kobre — the Coalsteel Kingdom (spiritual heart), Diamonds Kingdom (walled against homunculi, but which keeps Quench behind its wall), Elf Kingdom (elven exiles who adopted Gear for trade), and warily the Homunculi Kingdom itself — which keeps a parallel Quench on its side of the border, hammering on the same night without invitation or welcome.

    Economics¶

    Forge-Quench is the assay and futures market for Kobre steel and precision gear.

    • Currency spent: Kobran Gear — interlocking steel gears forged by homunculi to 0.02mm tolerance on water-powered hobbers. Teeth count is denomination: 12-tooth base, 24/36/48 higher. Gears mesh — stack a purse and turn the top; counterfeit jams. On Forge-Quench, all Kobre contracts for steel plate, coal, and furnace work are priced in Gears; the quench-masterwork is sold at auction in Gears, and its price becomes the continent's steel reference.

    Connections¶

    • Religion: Coal Doctrine — southern branch of Dwarvism, Coalsteel Kingdom communal hearth
    • Region: Kobre Continent — Coalsteel Kingdom, Diamonds Kingdom, Elf Kingdom, Homunculi Kingdom
    • Date: Day 5, Month 2 (Ge'orian Calendar) — deep winter forge, communal quench
    • Currency used: Kobran Gear — interlocking steel gear, teeth-count denomination
